item.title: Five dead in Northern Michigan; suspect also found dead
item.description: Authorities are investigating the deaths of five people in rural Northern Michigan; the suspect was also found dead.

item.title: Pilot walks away from jet crash, footage shows
item.description: New video captures the moment authorities met a pilot who ejected before his fighter jet crashed into a mountain.

item.title: Hawaii under hurricane warning as Tropical Storm Lala approaches
item.description: Tropical Storm Lala may bring heavy rain, strong winds, and dangerous surf to Hawaii as a hurricane this weekend.

item.title: At least 38 dead in powerful Indonesia earthquake
item.description: Indonesian authorities issued and then lifted a tsunami warning after the strong quake on Saturday morning.
